edits.new:
Reference data this story reads: the LOV-DELIVERY values, the mapping of a delivery status to the notice state, the notice-period duration and the proof window, each read as a versioned reference row under DP-06 and DP-07. Parameter keys are not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-ITG-E5002-ITG-20).

LOV-DELIVERY holds DELIVERED, REFUSED, UNDELIVERABLE and PENDING. DELIVERED moves the notice to Delivered; UNDELIVERABLE and REFUSED take the unserved end of BR2. Until the mapping row for PENDING is settled, a proof with PENDING is refused and leaves the notice unchanged. The list is read through the reference-data contract where it is available; the contract name and version are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1192).

Delivery fact in the target: the notice and its served result are held and read on the rwb-comms contract. The rwb-litigation read of the proof of delivery in `v_ace_pod` goes through the rwb-source-data ACE-data contract (one hop, 2 s timeout, faked); its operation name and the element read are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2744). rwb-litigation writes no business row for the delivery fact, and no sixth operation is added to the five of TSD S4 T-A.1. The harness itself reads no ACE view.

PROOF_OF_DELIVERY_RECEIVED, PROOF_WINDOW_EXPIRED and DELIVERY_FAILED are names of workflow signals, not Kafka subscriptions. The rwb-litigation step publishes and consumes no event for them. Its case read and case-stage answer go on the rwb-case contract, one hop with a 2 s timeout; their operation names are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2745). The events in section 12.4 are consumed by the harness only, as evidence.
